items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I met Howard Calendar somewhere. I'd never heard of him, you know, and he gave me this picture. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know any of the people.

ctx.x: with a package, you know, because everybody was -- they were all working out of [Moe] Gale's office, you know. So we -- we went in the Apollo three times, and we went -- time I was with him. I left him in October.
You weren't in the band when she had a fellow called Howard Calendar conducting it?
Yes, he was going with him and he was playing trumpet in the band.
